Grand Prix Runner is an exciting mobile game that captures the essence of RTVE's Grand Prix TV show. This runner game allows you to experience the adrenaline and fun of the show's most iconic challenges right in the palm of your hand. Designed for both avid fans of the show and action and racing game enthusiasts, Grand Prix Runner offers a unique blend of entertainment and challenge.

Main Features

1. Various Game Modes: Grand Prix Runner includes multiple game modes. From time trials in Single Player Mode to competitions for the best position between two participating villages. Choose your village and compete with friends and family in real-time, adding an extra layer of fun and friendly competition.
2. Iconic Challenges from the Show: The game features emblematic challenges such as Crazy Logs, Pilot Puppy, JurassicPrix, and Penguin Ducks, along with The Dictionary and Hot Potato. Participate in time trials set in environments filled with elements and obstacles, recreating the best moments of the show and immersing yourself in the world of Grand Prix. 3. Intuitive and Simple Controls: Easy to learn, allowing you to focus on the action and enjoy the game without unnecessary frustrations.
4. The Best for Last - Maria Fernanda the Cow: She is the absolute star of our game. Dodge dinosaurs, penguins, rocks, and fans to reach the finish line in record time.
Stay tuned for future updates where new challenges and customization options will be available!

Gameplay Experience

The game starts with selecting the number of players (1 or 2) and choosing the villages to represent, defending their respective colors. A brief tutorial will help you understand the basic controls and game mechanics. Once the tutorial is completed, you are ready to compete!

During the races, you must dodge obstacles, collect as many items as possible, and avoid falling into the pool or being eaten by Nico, the T-REX, before reaching the end of each level. Each level is inspired by a challenge from the TV show, featuring tasks like jumping barriers, dodging stones, and hopping from log to log without falling. The difficulty increases progressively, ensuring the game remains challenging and exciting as the competition advances.

And remember! Winning the Grand Prix isn't just about running fast; you must excel in culture and knowledge tests, answer correctly, and avoid having balloons burst in your face... because that can happen too!

Competition and Collaboration

Grand Prix Runner's multiplayer mode is one of its most attractive features. You can compete with a friend or family member in real-time on the same device, promoting social interaction and healthy competition. This mode not only adds an extra element of fun but also allows you to challenge others to beat you in the game's various trials.

Updates and Additional Content

As we mentioned before, the game will continuously update with multiple surprises! Stay tuned as we keep you informed whenever new challenges and game modes are included. Additionally, there will be special events and temporary challenges to keep the fun going.

Arcadia Sports is a collection of arcade games with a sports theme for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.

The collection consists of 12 games (with many more to come):

- Beach Ball
Match similar balls to form larger ones. Keep them in the box.

- Formula Race
Compete in the premier racing series and outpace your opponents with skillful overtaking maneuvers.

- Hoop Fever
Dribble, shoot and score. All with just one finger.

- Basket
Getting the ball in the hoop is a given. But what if the hoop had to target the ball instead?

- 8-Ball Pool
Classic 8-Ball in solo mode. Sink balls of one type (solid or striped) first and then the rest, culminating in the 8-ball.

- 9-Ball Pool
Hit the lowest numbered ball first, but numerical order isn't necessary for pocketing.

- Air Hockey
Similar to hockey, minus the ice and Zamboni. First to reach 10 points wins.

- CyberSoccer
Turn-based soccer, a new twist.
Each CyberPlayer manages a zone on the field. If the ball lands there, it's their turn.

- MiniGolf (Course A)
Golf, but downsized with compact courses full of obstacles and challenges.

- MiniGolf (Course B)
Similar to before, but with different courses (and challenges).

- Bowling
A classic! Knock down all the pins, preferably in one roll. Easier said than done, right?

- RainBowling
Bowling meets a rainbow, with explosive pins and obstacles. Not quite the rainbow we remember.

Is this a small offering? Don't worry!
This is just the beginning.
We're already working on new games that will be added to the collection over time.

Additional Features:
- Advanced support for Apple Watch (Series 1 to Series 8 and Ultra)
- 120 fps support on compatible devices
- iCloud support for saving progress
- Game Center support for online leaderboards
- No advertisements
- No tracking
